decisions.reason: As a newly launched Magento-related template close to the core hosting and shop business, it has recent sunk costs behind it and any weak uptake can still be seen as temporary.
The responsive website template fits the firm's established customer base and service logic, so management is likely to continue it rather than reverse course after such a recent launch.
Premium customer support is highly central to the firm's stated strategy of expert service and round-the-clock help, which makes withdrawal especially unlikely.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's technical platform ambitions and was given its own page, signaling visible commitment and making persistence likely.

Although the data processing contract tool is more distant from the core offer, the dedicated presentation and fresh investment still make management more likely to keep it for now than to abandon it.
